observation: Architecture critique caught an unbuildable plan PRE-BUILD, saving a wasted build. observation: Process improvement for /compound: the write-tests/write-code/review skills should explicitly name 'crashed' (and 'error') as NOT a valid real-run proof on any harness lane, because crashed-acceptance is the CC-004 false-green signature and it recurred here despite the whole AR track existing to kill it. A mechanical lint/guard rule — forbid 'crashed' inside a CLI-lane toContain(state/outcome) assertion — would pin what review caught by eye, the same way AR2 hardened the per-harness floor rather than just fixing the test.
